title: American Heart Association BLS & ACLS Guidelines
description: Evidence-based clinical guidelines and protocol algorithms for Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS), critical cardiac arrest management, and post-resuscitation care.

title: HHS Health Information Privacy & Security Training
platform: U.S. Dept of Health & Human Services
description: Official federal regulatory training on HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification rules for healthcare practitioners, safeguarding Protected Health Information (PHI) in Electronic Health Record (EHR) workflows.

title: Clinical ECG and Telemetry Interpretation Mastery
description: High-yield nursing tutorial breaking down rhythm strip analysis, sinus rhythms, heart blocks, tachyarrhythmias, and telemetry intervention protocols in acute care.

title: NCSBN Official NCLEX-RN Candidate Bulletin & Practice
description: Official US test plans, clinical judgment measurement models, and examination preparation resources for registered nurse licensure candidates in the United States.

title: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Clinical Workflows & Documentation
description: Practical training in computerized physician order entry (CPOE), patient chart reviews, clinical documentation, and interoperability across hospital EHR systems.

title: CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices
description: Standard evidence-based guidance on hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, sterilization, injection safety, and isolation protocols for acute inpatient facilities.

title: National Health Authority ABDM & Health Data Interoperability Standards
description: National Health Authority (NHA) technical architecture for Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). Covers ABHA health IDs, Health Information Exchange & Consent Manager (HIECM), and HL7 FHIR standards for Indian clinical systems.

title: NABH Hospital Accreditation Standards & Clinical Establishments Act Framework
description: National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH) standards and Clinical Establishments Act statutory framework. Covers Indian biomedical waste management rules, patient safety protocols, hospital clinical audits, and accreditation compliance.
